compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Reviewed nitrogen-equivalent complete native urea supply proxy. The exact source positive1kg urea references explicitly declare1kg dry urea and nitrogen mass fraction0.466461632733939kgN/kg. Native UVEK Urea,asN,atregionalstorehouse has positive1kgN reference; documentation gives about2.17kgurea at46.0%N. Supply0.466461632733939kgN per signed sourcekg, preserving the recorded nitrogen quantity. Do not use factor1, an inverse46%multiplier or a ratio derived from the rounded2.17kg description. Preserve signs, supported uncertainties and formulas with the same positive factor. This is N-equivalent, not exact source/native product-mass, purity or carbon-composition equivalence: native fertiliser-grade specifications and rounded product-mass information can differ from source pure-urea properties. Reuse the complete existing RER regional-storehouse inventory, including native production, precursor supply, energy, infrastructure and final delivery once. The source market internal producer shares and freight are replaced by that complete native supply model; do not add source freight or source production again. RER is an explicit geographic/production-route screening proxy for CN and RoW. Native ammonia/feedstock, allocation, CO2 accounting, vintage, losses, emissions and internal uncertainty differ. Native documentation excludes CO2 consumption from the production inventory because it is treated as an ammonia by-product, and excludes catalyst waste treatment, coating and packaging; biosphere exclusions also remain. Score and carbon-balance effects are unquantified. Add no atmospheric CO2 uptake, fertiliser field/application emissions, avoided-emission credit, carbon, moisture or purity correction. Separate caller emissions and carbon-resource exchanges remain unchanged. Only the16independently inspected exact cut-off source profiles qualify. The two exact3.6suppliers were absent and are not approved; no consequential, reverse or uninspected-profile fallback is inferred. Pulp heat and steel transformation/export remain unfinished.
